# CHUM — A Tribute to Phish

> San Francisco Bay Area Phish tribute band active since 2010, performing Phish's intricate compositions and multi-era live improvisation across Northern California and the West Coast.

Founded in 2010 in the San Francisco Bay Area, Chum is one of the longest-running Phish tribute acts in the United States. The band tackles Phish's most demanding composed material alongside open-ended, multi-era improvisation spanning Phish 1.0 through 4.0, plus Phish's live arrangements of classic rock covers.

Lineup: Eric Ingersoll (Keys & Vocals), Chris Detrick (Guitar & Vocals), Chad Kimner (Bass & Vocals), and Alex Bowman (Drums & Vocals), with occasional guest appearances on guitar from Sweden by Eric Schiff. In memory of keyboardist and vocalist John Greene (March 2014 – July 2025).

Notable venues played include Cornerstone (Berkeley, CA), Felton Music Hall (Felton, CA), Moe's Alley (Santa Cruz, CA), Woodhouse Blending & Brewing (Santa Cruz, CA), The Crepe Place (Santa Cruz, CA), HopMonk Tavern (Sebastopol & Novato, CA), Ivy Room (Albany, CA), Ballers Stadium (Oakland, CA), Green Room Social Club (Placerville, CA), Crazy Horse Saloon (Nevada City, CA), and Shakedown at Tuscany Suites (Las Vegas, NV — Phish Sphere After Party).

Booking inquiries: nobrainerproductions831@gmail.com (No Brainer Productions). General band contact: chumphishtribute@gmail.com.
